web-guide-idea-69.audience: Beginners who want to build a small working project.
web-guide-idea-69.offer: Guide a modest project step by step and explain what each part does. Keep the scope realistic for learners who need time to try it.
web-guide-idea-69.steps.0: Send setup instructions and a simple starting point.
web-guide-idea-69.steps.1: Build in small stages with pauses for questions.
web-guide-idea-69.steps.2: Review the result and suggest one independent extension.
web-guide-idea-69.equipment: Participants usually need a computer with the agreed coding tools; a phone can carry the call.
web-guide-idea-69.returnReason: Develop a sequence of small projects with one new concept in each.
web-guide-idea-69.promotion: Show the finished sample and prerequisites so participants know what they will build.
web-guide-idea-69.metadataTitle: Beginner Coding Lab — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · avaTOK
web-guide-idea-69.metadataDescription: Build a small project together, explaining each step and helping participants when they get stuck. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
